Your change engine.
Motors and drives are our business redefining reliable motion from check-time per day to uptime per lifecycle, from simply on/off to everything smart in between. Our most powerful engine: more than 15,000 dedicated experts, doers, colleagues. For them, engineering the future means keeping businesses in motion – in e-motion. We are the “we” in power – and we can empower you.
15,000 and counting.
Are you looking for the stability of an established global player with the lean, innovative spirit of a mid-size hidden champion? That’s us! Are you looking to shape entire industries with a future-proof portfolio of more sustainable, energy efficient solutions? Deal, let’s go!
Your future role.
LV/HV Motors and Medium Voltage Drive services, service and spare parts offer and order management.
7/24 Coordination of end user requests between warehouse, service team and factories.
Follow up installed base and opportunities
Work with service and sales teams for new opportunities, retrofits (service & maintenance contracts, spare parts, digital services and condition monitoring contracts).
Build relationships and network with key players at customer sites
Perform commissioning, fault intervention/elimination and maintenance for Motors and Medium Voltage Drives,
Perform commissioning of digital solutions IQ systems- a holistic solution and service to the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) for MV Drives and HV Motors
Work in close cooperation with sales teams to ensure effective lead generation for new product, retrofit and service sales (service & maintenance contracts, spare parts, digital services and condition monitoring contract)
Give constructive feedback to sales and service operations to increase process quality and customer satisfaction
Your profile.
Passion for service, flexible 7/24 working hours and no restirictions for both domestic and abroad travelling
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or Electrical&Electronics Engineering with power systems background
Very good knowledge in Power Electronics, Electrical Motors & Drives. Basic knowledge in MV Switchgear systems
Ability to meet demanding schedule requirements without compromising quality and EHS
Minimum +5 years of experience in maintenance teams of factories or service teams of related product suppliers
Languages: must be fluent in spoken and written Turkish & English
Make your mark in our exciting world. #JoinReliableMotion #TeamInnomotics
